title: Mechanisms of transcriptional regulation in Anopheles gambiae revealed by allele specific expression
authors: Dyer NA; Lucas ER; Nagi SC; McDermott DP; Brenas JH; Miles A; Clarkson CS; Mawejje HD; Wilding CS; Halfon MS; Asma H; Heinz E; Donnelly MJ
one_liner_zh: 该文通过等位基因特异性表达和机器学习预测顺式调控模块，研究按蚊基因表达调控，但未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合机制，仅间接相关。
abstract:
Malaria control relies on insecticides targeting the mosquito vector, but this is increasingly compromised by insecticide resistance, which can be achieved by elevated expression of detoxifying enzymes that metabolize the insecticide. In diploid organisms, gene expression is regulated both in cis , by regulatory sequences on the same chromosome, and by trans acting factors, affecting both alleles equally. Differing levels of transcription can be caused by mutations in cis -regulatory modules (CRM), but few of these have been identified in mosquitoes. We crossed bendiocarb resistant and susceptible Anopheles gambiae strains to identify cis -regulated genes that might be responsible for the resistant phenotype using RNAseq, and cis -regulatory module sequences controlling gene expression in insecticide resistance relevant tissues were predicted using machine learning. We found 115 genes showing allele specific expression in hybrids of insecticide susceptible and resistant strains, suggesting cis regulation is an important mechanism of gene expression regulation in Anopheles gambiae . The genes showing allele specific expression included a higher proportion of Anopheles specific genes on average younger than genes those with balanced allelic expression.

Author Summary

The evolution of insecticide resistance, including resistance that is due to changes in the expression levels of certain resistance associated genes is threatening progress in malaria control. We investigated how the expression of genes in the malaria vector Anopheles gambiae is controlled, by implementing a method for the first time in this species. Each mosquito inherits a set of chromosomes from both parents, so has a maternal and paternal copy of most genes. When a gene is expressed, the DNA encoding that gene is transcribed into messenger RNA. This process is controlled by the cellular environment and by other DNA sequences on the same chromosome as each gene. We crossed mosquitoes from insecticide resistant and susceptible strains to equalize the cellular environment and then measured the levels of messenger RNA from both gene copies. 115 genes showed consistently different messenger RNA levels between gene copies in most crosses, suggesting these genes are regulated by factors on the same chromosome. There were relatively more Anopheles specific genes with imbalanced expression. Using machine learning we identified DNA sequences that may be responsible for controlling gene expression in mosquito tissues; several of these sequences were close to genes with imbalanced expression.
abstract_zh:
疟疾控制依赖于针对蚊媒的杀虫剂，但这一策略正日益受到杀虫剂抗性的威胁，而抗性可通过代谢杀虫剂的解毒酶表达升高来实现。在二倍体生物中，基因表达既受同一染色体上调控序列的顺式 (cis) 调节，也受反式 (trans) 作用因子的影响，后者对两个等位基因的影响相同。转录水平的差异可能由顺式调控模块 (cis-regulatory modules, CRM) 中的突变引起，但在蚊子中已鉴定的此类模块很少。我们通过将抗残杀威 (bendiocarb) 和敏感的冈比亚按蚊 (Anopheles gambiae) 品系杂交，利用RNAseq鉴定可能负责抗性表型的顺式调控基因，并利用机器学习预测在杀虫剂抗性相关组织中控制基因表达的顺式调控模块序列。我们在杀虫剂敏感和抗性品系杂交后代中发现了115个显示等位基因特异性表达的基因，表明顺式调控是冈比亚按蚊基因表达调控的重要机制。显示等位基因特异性表达的基因中，按蚊特有基因的比例较高，平均而言这些基因比等位基因表达平衡的基因更年轻。

作者总结

杀虫剂抗性的进化，包括由某些抗性相关基因表达水平变化引起的抗性，正威胁着疟疾控制的进展。我们通过首次在该物种中实施一种方法，研究了疟疾媒介冈比亚按蚊中基因表达的控制方式。每只蚊子从父母双方各继承一套染色体，因此大多数基因都有母源和父源两个拷贝。当基因表达时，编码该基因的DNA被转录为信使RNA。这一过程受细胞环境以及每个基因所在同一染色体上的其他DNA序列调控。我们将杀虫剂抗性和敏感品系的蚊子杂交，以均衡细胞环境，然后测量两个基因拷贝的信使RNA水平。在大多数杂交组合中，115个基因的两个拷贝之间的信使RNA水平持续存在差异，表明这些基因受同一染色体上的因子调控。表达失衡的按蚊特有基因相对较多。利用机器学习，我们鉴定了可能负责控制蚊子组织中基因表达的DNA序列；其中几个序列位于表达失衡基因附近。
